name: What is the typical process for engaging AKN Design Group for an emergency repair that requires extensive renovation?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for engaging AKN Design Group for an emergency repair that requires extensive renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process for managing significant emergency repairs that lead to extensive renovations begins with an initial consultation to assess the damage and understand the scope of work. We then develop a detailed design and construction plan, integrating the necessary repairs with your desired aesthetic and functional enhancements. This includes permit coordination, material selection, and a transparent project timeline. Our integrated design-build approach ensures a single point of coordination, moving from the initial damage mitigation through comprehensive reconstruction and final walkthrough. This managed process is designed to minimize your stress and deliver a cohesive, high-quality outcome.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process for extensive emergency repairs involves an initial damage assessment, followed by a detailed design and construction plan, permit coordination, and a managed build through to completion.
